title: Vacation Release Days Worksheet
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — the released vacation fill of a granted vacation override.**

**Rule.** The vacation release is the plan's most extra days supply one vacation override releases less the days still on hand from the latest paid refill of the drug, which are that refill's days supply less the calendar days since it was filled, never below zero, and the release is never fewer than one day. The release never exceeds the plan's most extra days supply one vacation override releases, and it is a whole number of days.

The drug is the drug of the latest vacation override granted on the coverage; its supply is measured from the latest paid refill of that drug.

### Working lines

| Line | Entry |
|---|---|
| A | The plan's most extra days supply one vacation override releases |
| B | Days on hand: the latest refill's days supply less the calendar days since it was filled, never below zero |
| C | A less B, never below zero |
| D | Release: C, never fewer than one day and never more than A |

### Worked figures (hypothetical plan figure of 34 extra days)

| Latest paid refill | Days since it was filled | Days on hand | Release |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 days | 20 | 10 | 24 |
| 30 days | 35 | 0 | 34 |
| 90 days | 10 | 80 | 1 (never fewer than one day) |
